recipes.name: Orange Beef Kabobs with Grilled Fruit
ingredients_raw: 1 pound top sirloin, cut into 1-inch cubes
2 large red bell peppers, cut into 2 inch pieces
1 large red onion, cut into wedges

steps.text: Place beef cubes, yogurt, orange zest, ginger, and cayenne pepper in a large resealable plastic freezer bag, squeeze out excess air, and seal the bag. Massage the bag until beef is well coated. Marinate in the refrigerator at least 2 hours.
Preheat an outdoor grill for medium heat and lightly oil the grate.
Remove beef from marinade; shake off excess. Discard remaining marinade. Thread bell peppers, onion, and beef cubes onto skewers; brush with olive oil.

Place pineapple and orange in the center of a large piece of heavy-duty aluminum foil; dot with butter, sprinkle with brown sugar, and drizzle with rum. Bring long sides of foil together and seal well; fold up and seal each end.
Cook kabobs and fruit packets on the preheated grill, covered, turning kabobs occasionally, until beef is done to your liking and fruit is soft and glazed, about 10 minutes.

raw_recipe.headline: Orange Beef Kabobs with Grilled Fruit
raw_recipe.description: For this orange beef kabobs with grilled fruit recipe, sweet orange and pineapple chunks are grilled in a foil package along with marinated beef kabobs.

review.reviewBody: Didn't have rum and used Chuck Roast instead of Sirloin. Didn't matter to my discerning household, thumbs up all around and a drop of the recipe into the "Will Make Again" folder of the recipe box. Great recipe!!

I love the grilled fruit in this recipe. I used rum extract as I didn't have any rum, and you wouldn't know the difference. The marinade imparted a subtle citrus flavor to the meat. You must be a fan of citrus to like that. It was a good counterpart for the fruit. I served this with the asian coconut rice recipe from this site. Nice all round change from the ordinary.

The marinade for the meat is not very tasty. The yogurt thickens into clumps while cooking on the grill, not a very pleasing texture. Gave this 3 stars because the grilled fruit is very good! In fact we ended up eating the grilled fruit with the rice and threw the kabobs away.
